notes: Covers synchronous and asynchronous initialization patterns.
Exact settings fields and signatures must be rechecked from the official docs.

route_families.title: User and authentication
notes: Includes custom, guest, federation, and token-based login flows.
Use a narrower child route before answering mutable provider or implementation details.

route_families.title: Federation login
notes: Use this family for federation login, signup, migration, and provider-specific setup questions.
Supported providers and permission details are mutable and must be rechecked from the official docs.

route_families.title: Game information
notes: Shared gameplay data patterns and table operations.
Pick a narrower child route before generating production code.

route_families.title: Player data
notes: Per-player data operations, reads, writes, and transactions.
Payload limits and reserved-field behavior should be rechecked upstream.

route_families.title: Leaderboard (current ranking system)
notes: Current, recommended ranking system. Supports group-segmented leaderboards and unmarshalled return values.
Use this family for all new ranking work; it has user and guild sub-families.
The /leaderboard index path is not a page (404). Route to a specific child such as user/get-leaderboard.

route_families.title: Rank (legacy URank, deprecated)
notes: Legacy URank ranking, superseded by the leaderboard family.
Official rank docs pages are unpublished (draft) and return 404 — route to leaderboard instead.
URank.* may still exist in the SDK for older integrations; see leaderboard/difference-to-rank for migration.

route_families.title: Receipt and payment
notes: Includes platform-specific receipt verification flows.
Store-specific console setup and payload rules must be rechecked upstream.

route_families.title: Base-side function calls
notes: Client-side function listing and invocation from BACKND Base.
Do not confuse this with Function product authoring docs.

route_families.title: Error catalog
notes: Broad error index for status and error-code driven troubleshooting.
Exact error wording should be matched against upstream pages or live payloads.

route_families.title: Notify and handlers
notes: Connection lifecycle and handler categories for realtime notifications.
Reconnect and authorization details should be revalidated from the official docs.

route_families.title: Operation notices
notes: Operational notices surfaced from the platform.

route_families.title: Operation events
notes: Operational event listing and lookup routes.

route_families.title: BACKND Function product
notes: Separate product documentation for building and deploying backend functions.
Toolchain requirements and downloads must be rechecked from the official docs.

route_families.title: Implementation guideline (step-by-step)
notes: End-to-end onboarding walkthroughs with all-code samples.
Verify exact calls against the matching feature topic; prefer leaderboard over the rank walkthrough.

route_families.title: SDK usage patterns
notes: Cross-cutting patterns: sync/async/SendQueue, Param, BackendReturnObject parsing, inDate.
Category path is not a page; route to a specific child.

route_families.title: Example game tutorials
notes: Complete sample games (Idle Tycoon, Idle, Highscore).
Illustrative code; verify each call against its feature topic.

notes: How to respond to recurring runtime errors and register handlers.

route_families.title: Cloud save (low-cost storage)
notes: Collection-based file/data storage; no backup, no request logs.
Steer loss-sensitive data to database or game-information.

route_families.title: Group data
notes: Console-defined groups; underpins group-segmented leaderboards.
Distinct from guild membership.

route_families.title: Coupon
notes: List (new and legacy), use, and web coupons.

route_families.title: Push notifications
notes: Device-token registration; separate Android and iOS flows; night-push is opt-out.
Delivery requires console push setup.

route_families.title: Game log
notes: InsertLogV2 (no DB write throughput cost); legacy InsertLog incurs cost.

route_families.title: Chart (CDN game data)
notes: CDN-delivered design data via Backend.CDN.Content, with local caching.
Category path is not a page; route to a specific child.

route_families.title: Probability (CDN gacha)
notes: CDN-delivered probability cards via Backend.CDN.Probability; console-authoritative odds.

route_families.title: Cash / TBC (discontinued)
notes: TBC is discontinued (SDK 5.18.7 and below only).
Route new purchase work to the receipt family.

route_families.title: Find user
notes: Lookup by nickname or gamer inDate; v2 variants preferred over legacy.

route_families.title: Random search (RandomPool)
notes: Current RandomPool system; legacy Social/Guild random functions are deprecated.

route_families.title: Friend
notes: Friend list and request lifecycle (send/receive/accept/refuse/cancel).

route_families.title: Post / mailbox (UPost)
notes: Current UPost mailbox (oldest-first paging); legacy Social.Post read latest-100 only.
Post kinds: administrator, rank, coupon, user, webshop.

route_families.title: Message (player notes)
notes: 1:1 player notes; length limited by console; distinct from post/mailbox.

route_families.title: Guild
notes: Create/join/search and member, guild-master, operator tiers.
Guild ranking is served by the leaderboard guild family.

route_families.title: Region / location
notes: IP-based location cached at login/token-reissue; VPN can break detection.

route_families.title: Country code
notes: CountryCode enum (196 countries) for console-side country filtering.

route_families.title: SDK utilities
notes: Server time, project status/version, signature hash, filesystem; some usable without login.
